name: Clan-Animal Speaker (Racial)
body:
You can speak with animals affiliated with your clan.

Prerequisite: Hengeyokai, Wisdom 13

Benefit: You gain speak with animals as a spell-like ability so long as the animal being spoken to is the same as the one you can change into using your racial shapechanger ability. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your your Wisdom bonus.
